mapper.select: SELECT C.ID AS id , C.POST_ID AS postId , C.MEM_EMAIL AS memEmail , M.MEM_NICKNAME AS memNickname , C.CONTENT AS content , C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , C.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt , M.MEM_PROFILE_IMG AS memProfileImg , NULL AS postTitle , NULL AS postWriterNickname FROM COMMENTS C LEFT JOIN MEM_INFO M ON C.MEM_EMAIL = M.MEM_EMAIL WHERE C.POST_ID = #{postId} ORDER BY C.CREATED_AT ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMENTS SET CONTENT = #{content} , UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT C.ID AS id , C.POST_ID AS postId , C.MEM_EMAIL AS memEmail , MI.MEM_NICKNAME AS memNickname , C.CONTENT AS content , C.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , C.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt , MI.MEM_PROFILE_IMG AS memProfileImg , P.TITLE AS postTitle , PI.MEM_NICKNAME AS postWriterNickname FROM COMMENTS C LEFT JOIN MEM_INFO MI ON C.MEM_EMAIL = MI.MEM_EMAIL LEFT JOIN POSTS P ON C.POST_ID = P.ID LEFT JOIN MEM_INFO PI ON P.MEM_EMAIL = PI.MEM_EMAIL WHERE C.MEM_EMAIL = #{memEmail} ORDER BY (SELECT MAX(CREATED_AT) FROM COMMENTS WHERE POST_ID = C.POST_ID AND MEM_EMAIL = #{memEmail}) DESC , C.CREATED_AT DESC
